question: Is p0 hidden spectral recoverability evidence of a concept learned by that training objective?
conclusion: No: same-seed random initialization decodes the tone better than p0 training in all four architecture/seed pairs.
limitations: Fixed supervised ridge; input baseline is stronger; same inspected TEST histories; failure of a linear probe is not absence of information.
next_step: Preserve initialization and input baselines in subsequent interpretation; distinguish forecast gain from learned representation claims.
